Commentary: India have won the toss and have opted to field
India (Playing XI): Sanju Samson(w), Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer(c), Tilak Varma, Naman Dhir, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Axar Patel, Arshdeep Singh, Prince Yadav, Mayank Yadav
West Indies (Playing XI): Shai Hope(w/c), Jewel Andrew, Shimron Hetmyer, Rovman Powell, Sherfane Rutherford, Romario Shepherd, Roston Chase, Keemo Paul, Shamar Springer, Gudakesh Motie, Shamar Joseph

We are all set to go. This is a massively high-scoring ground and will we see 300 breached tonight? We saw a beaming smile from Shreyas at the toss. Is it advantage India? Or can West Indies do what India did to them in the last game? A packed crowd in at the RGIS. India in a huddle at the moment. They break out with Shreyas and Axar sporting big smiles. Ishan too has one. Out walk the players. A new opening combo for West Indies with Shai Hope and Jewel Andrew out there. One Barbadian and the other Jamaican. The bell is rung and we are all set....

Mayank Yadav will start off for India. He was pacy and nippy in the last game. Let's see how he goes tonight. Lovely night in Hyderabad and the packed stadium will be hoping for a great game. The countdown is done. Here we go...
Shai Hope and Jewel Andrew are at the crease. Shai Hope is on strike. Mayank Yadav will open the attack

Mayank Yadav to Shai Hope, 1 run, short of length and extra bounce on off, Shai Hope closes the face of the bat and nudges it to deep backward square-leg to get off the mark. Handled the bounce well there
Mayank Yadav to Jewel Andrew, no run, short of length and tight on middle, bit of angle in, Jewel Andrew goes on the back foot to defend to mid-wicket
A packed off-side field - similar to the last game, in a ring from short third man to mid-off. 6 out there including the keeper.
Mayank Yadav to Jewel Andrew, no run, fullish on off, Jewel Andrew gets forward and defends solidly to cover

Mayank Yadav to Jewel Andrew, 2 runs, that's pace for you. Right at the throat of Jewel Andrew who goes on the back foot and awkwardly pulls, off the glove to deep backward square-leg and there's a direct-hit at the bowler's end. The ricochet takes it away from mid-on and one turns into two
Mayank Yadav to Jewel Andrew, no run, full on off, Jewel Andrew gets forward to drive and finds backward point, good shot for no run
Mayank Yadav to Jewel Andrew, no run, that's pressure talking. Jewel Andrew wants to break free. He comes down the track and this is short and rising outside off, throws the bat at that and misses
Arshdeep Singh, left-arm fast medium, comes into the attack
Arshdeep Singh to Shai Hope, 1 run, from round the wicket. Angle in, length delivery and Shai Hope gets forward to nudge it in front of mid-on. Easy single

Arshdeep Singh to Jewel Andrew, SIX, what a blow that is. He is a talent for sure. Arshdeep Singh comes over the wicket and it's a length delivery on off, such a clean heave over mid-wicket and it's all the way. Jewel Andrew getting forward and smashing it. Right off the middle of the bat
Arshdeep Singh to Jewel Andrew, no run, good comeback that. Fine yorker just outside off, Jewel Andrew tries to dig it out and misses. That's a fine delivery after being hit for six the last ball
